mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, category_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update:
UPDATE post
title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, is_top = #{isTop}, is_essence = #{isEssence}, category_id = #{categoryId},
update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, view_count = #{viewCount},
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM post WHERE status = 1 -- 只查询已发布的帖子 ORDER BY view_count DESC, is_essence DESC, is_top DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT p.*, u.username, c.name as category FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id
SELECT p.*, u.username, c.name as category FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
SELECT p.*, u.username, c.name as category FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND type = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND type = 2

SELECT p.*, u.username, c.name as category FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN interaction i ON p.id = i.post_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.type = 2 AND p. status = 1
